events.subtitle: 2nd Album Release Live — Abide in Grace
events.factual_description: BLUES ALLEY JAPAN presents Yoshinori Imai's second-album release live, Abide in Grace, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, as Day 2 of his Birthday Live 2026 Special 2Days. The venue publishes two separate seatings starting at 4:00 PM and 7:30 PM and names Masato Honda, Takashi Masuzaki, Mitsuru Sutoh and Keiji Matsumoto with Imai on drums. The exact venue pages currently show general reservations open; the first and second seatings are separately ticketed. Sutoh's current musician schedule independently corroborates the date, billing and complete five-person lineup. Imai's official profile confirms his drummer identity and broader fusion-oriented work, including CASIOPEA-P4.

enrichment.note: Both set times, venue, complete quintet and album-release billing are verified from BLUES ALLEY JAPAN and corroborated by Mitsuru Sutoh's current schedule. The venue currently lists advance table seats at ¥7,000, with higher-priced plate and dinner sets, but its reservation control is embedded in the event page; no separate purchase URL or unreleased Apple Music destination is invented.

Repository searches for Abide in Grace and for Yoshinori Imai in Japanese returned no matching candidate before publication, and the merge gate accepted this event ID into its added set. Priority was assigned after admission; the specific drummer-led release quintet makes the event RADAR-worthy, while two seatings and no documented scarcity make attend-if-convenient treatment the durable recommendation.

en.why_it_matters: The release context has a real instrumental center: Imai puts the drums in front of a Japanese-fusion quintet with Honda, Masuzaki, Sutoh and Matsumoto, so the attraction is the interaction of saxophone, guitar, keys, bass and a drummer-composer's rhythmic architecture around new record material. The lineup is the reason this clears RADAR, not the birthday framing by itself.
en.trip_verdict: If November 3 falls inside a Tokyo stay, attend whichever seating fits the evening. Two separate shows provide useful flexibility, so this works best as a strong Meguro addition around rarer Tokyo anchors rather than a night that reorganizes the whole itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: El lanzamiento tiene un centro instrumental real: Imai pone la batería al frente de un quinteto de fusión japonesa con Honda, Masuzaki, Sutoh y Matsumoto, de modo que el atractivo está en cómo sax, guitarra, teclados y bajo se mueven dentro de la arquitectura rítmica de un baterista-compositor alrededor del nuevo material. La formación es la razón para meterlo al RADAR, no el cumpleaños por sí solo.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 3 de noviembre cae dentro de una estancia en Tokio, iría al horario que mejor embone con la noche. Las dos funciones dan margen suficiente para usarlo como una gran adición en Meguro alrededor de anclas más raras, sin reordenar todo el itinerario por esta fecha.
